$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: CopyButton
whenToUse: Next to a value people paste somewhere else: an API key, a DNS record, a command, a link.
When selecting the text by hand would be fiddly (long, monospaced, partly hidden).

whenNotToUse.text: A secret that should stay masked until asked

whenNotToUse.instead: a Share action or the URL itself

do.caption: Right next to the value it copies, and the name says which value.
do.example: ns1.theya.dev

dont.caption: One “Copy” for two values — which one did it take?
dont.example: ns1.theya.dev ns2.theya.dev

a11y: The confirmation is announced (“Copied”), not only shown by the icon swap.
Icon-only needs an `aria-label` naming the value: “Copy API key”, not just “Copy”.
If copying fails, say so — wire `onCopyError` to a toast.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render onto the child element instead of a <button> (shadcn/Radix Slot convention).

props.name: badge
props.description:
Count or status pinned to the top-right corner (a BadgeIndicator, sm,
circle). Pass a number/short text (`badge={5}`, `badge="9+"`), or an
object for a dot or another tone: `{ dot: true }`, `{ value: 3, tone: 'info' }`.
Default tone is danger. Not rendered with `asChild`.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description:
What the badge means, read after the button's name ("5 unread",
"new"). The badge itself is aria-hidden — without this, screen
reader users get no count at all. Dev warning when missing.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Label shown for `resetDelay`ms after a successful copy. Default "Copied".

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Renders as a square icon-only button (no label). Provide the icon via leftIcon.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label beside the icon. Pass null for icon-only (then set aria-label). Default "Copy".

props.name: resetDelay
props.description: ms before the button reverts from the copied state. Default 1500.

props.name: softDisabled
props.description:
Soft-disable: looks disabled and ignores clicks/Enter/Space, but stays
in the tab order and keeps receiving hover/focus (uses aria-disabled
instead of the native `disabled` attribute). Use it when the user needs
to find the button and learn WHY it's unavailable — wrap it in a
Tooltip with the reason. `disabled` stays the hard version (removed
from the tab order, no events at all).

props.name: success
props.description:
The action just succeeded: a tick draws itself in place of leftIcon (Kinetics'
Status Pill, MIT). Pair it with a label that says so ("Deployed") and, usually,
`tone="success"`; turn it off again after a moment. Not supported with asChild.
